name: io.github.yss787976-ai/aqb-agent
description: AQB wallet, payment, quote and USDC-redeem tools for AI agents on Base, with post-quantum identities.

environmentVariables.name: AQB_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a registered agent or its ECDSA fallback. Required only for write tools.

environmentVariables.name: AQB_RPC
environmentVariables.description: Base RPC URL; defaults to https://mainnet.base.org.
